description: This file defines a generic class `AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler<TEntity>`, which implements `IStreamFailureHandler`. It handles stream delivery failures by recording them into Azure Table Storage, including initialization, failure handling methods, and internal logic for creating and storing failure entities.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler<TEntity>
classes.description: A generic failure handler for streaming that logs failures to Azure Table Storage. It manages failure recording for stream delivery and subscription failures, with initialization and failure handling functionality.

methods.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the failure handler with serializer, logger factory, fault behavior, cluster ID, storage options, and an optional entity creation delegate.

methods.name: InitAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Azure Table storage table via the data manager.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles delivery failure notifications for streams, delegating to the internal OnFailure method.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles subscription failure notifications for streams, delegating to the internal OnFailure method.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Private async method that creates a failure entity with failure details and writes it into Azure Table Storage.
